    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=bg]
    cy=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); cx=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        seen=set()
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if (i,j) in seen or grid[i][j]==bg: continue
                c=grid[i][j]; line=[]; a,b=i,j
                while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b]==c and (a,b) not in seen:
